rationale: C07 is an exceptionally close reusable template. It uses the same three-part recital sequence, the same Railway Labor Act emergency-board machinery, the same represented labor organization, and nearly verbatim operative provisions. The child chiefly substitutes the railroad, location, and related geographic wording. C05 and C09 also provide nearly identical structural and literal templates, but C07 is strongest because it additionally matches the Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen and the localized formulation referring to a portion of the country.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Aliquippa and Southern Railroad Company, a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen, a labor organization
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between The Akron & Barberton Belt Railroad, a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen, a labor organization
shared_material.explanation: The opening recital has the same syntax, party roles, and labor organization, with only the carrier changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended

shared_material.child_excerpt: threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce within the State of Pennsylvania to a degree such as to deprive that portion of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce within the state of Ohio, to a degree such as to deprive that portion of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.explanation: The distinctive finding is nearly verbatim, with the state substituted.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Aliquippa and Southern Railroad Company or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by The Akron & Barberton Belt Railroad or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The substantive standstill provision is copied almost word for word, substituting only the regulated carrier.
